d.title: Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse Recap - Climax Chokuzen Special
d.jp: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ トータル・イクリプス 総集編 クライマックス直前スペシャル
d.synopsis: A recap primarily of episodes 3-19, this special aired prior to episode 20.  It also included the new OP/ED of the series and a preview of what's to come in future episodes.
